findings.claim: Recorded CLI arm is baseline data unless fresh CLI mode is enabled; the phase spec identifies the 387ms CLI result as an older cross-provider/model run.
Use frozen holdout rows with independent blinded labels, paired same-window arms and confidence intervals; separate coverage, correctness, parity, and option-order robustness.
Future cost and performance telemetry should include both arms and all fallback work.
The measured Pi usage rate scales to about $2.24 per 100,000 calls or $22.40 per million, subject to unchanged usage mix and excluding unknown CLI/fallback costs.
Default-on requires provider preservation, a quality/cost gate, bounded fallback latency, per-call/environment rollback, and canary rollout.
Fallback operational risks should be tested per gate with non-sensitive telemetry.
noul and score stay outside current adapter and benchmark scope.
Known packet phase/scorer and inventory contradictions qualify provenance/exhaustiveness, not the independently persisted report fields.

unresolvedQuestions: No unresolved user question; future causal cost savings remain unknown until a paired cost instrument and actual call volume are available.
